load.missing: This event no longer exists or is not an EventHelper event.

start.label: Start from what?
start.tip: Latest event: takes over title, description and time; the channel is cloned for the new date. Raid template: instances, size, tanks and healers — still editable for this event.
start.emptySub: Pick a category; the rest comes from its default template

termin.title: Title
termin.durationTip: How long the raid lasts, in minutes ({min}–{max}). This gives the end time — it appears in the signup message and limits the Discord event.
termin.categoryTipEdit: The event stays in its channel and category.
termin.categoryTip: Decides the default template, the channel schema and whether signups run through EventHelper or Raid-Helper.
termin.leaderTip: Who leads the event: you, the people signed up, or another Discord id.
termin.descriptionTip: Optional. Shown in the event message below the title.

raid.templateBadgeSub: The values came from this template. Changes here only apply to this event.
raid.fitTipSub: Tanks, healers and the melee/ranged minimums fit into the raid.
raid.more: More: appearance, melee/ranged, required buffs, setup, waiting list
raid.fairnessTip: Whoever sat on the bench last time is preferred in the setup suggestion.
raid.wishesTip: “Likes to raid with” from the profiles feeds into the setup suggestion.
raid.autoSuggestTip: At the signup deadline a setup suggestion is created automatically — a draft someone has to approve.
raid.overflowTip: Once the raid is full, every new signup that takes a spot (“Signed up” and “Late”) goes to the bench — the raider is told right away. Off: the signup is refused. Anyone who already has a spot keeps it.
raid.lockAtLimitTip: As soon as all spots are taken, signups close as if done by hand. If someone drops out, they do not reopen by themselves.

kanal.sourceTip: Prefilled from the category (Settings → Categories). EventHelper: own signup with raid planning. Raid-Helper: as before, with a Raid-Helper template.
kanal.staysSub: An event does not move when edited — create a new event for a different channel.
kanal.channelTip: New: a channel in the category, named by its schema (Channels). Clone: the channel #{channel} with permissions and topic. Existing: a channel that already exists.
kanal.voiceTip: Where the raid meets. Shown as its own line in the signup message and used as the location of the Discord event. Prefilled from the category (Settings → Categories).
kanal.announceTip: Posts a short line with title, date and a signup link and pings the category's raider role. Prefilled from Settings → Categories; happens exactly once per event.
kanal.deadlineTip: Hours before the raid starts; empty = no signup deadline.
kanal.rhTemplateTip: Which roles, classes and spots the event has. Offered are the raid templates with a linked Raid-Helper template; the category's default template is preselected.
